propositions: Filtered tickets pack size hovers near the 131072 KiB CI gate limit, causing stale-based changes to fail pack verification; proactive repack and gc will add headroom.
Approximately 1 GiB of spent/unreachable history in the tickets branch cannot be reclaimed by repack alone and requires git fast-export filter-rewrite followed by gc.
The .bridge_state/ tree accumulates scattered historical commits (12.79 KB per version measured) that survive standard repack even with aggressive depth/window parameters.

Coordinated execution with bug 30d3-eaf0-c7a4-497a diagnostic repair must occur in a single quiet window with explicit operator confirmation of zero active sessions and stopped rebar-mcp servers before any store mutation.

History rewrite, gc, and publication must be validated with exact force-with-lease, off-repo bundles, tree/commit/merge-count identity checks, identity-report multiset equivalence, and ref-pin convergence before writers resume.
